infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: OfflineSMS uses your camera to capture and share photos in conversations.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: OfflineSMS uses your microphone to record and send voice messages.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: OfflineSMS accesses your photo library to share images in conversations.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: OfflineSMS saves received media to your photo library.
infoPlist.NSContactsUsageDescription: OfflineSMS uses your contacts to help you find and message people.
